integrity: Proof includes all-parameter inequalities and equality classifications; exact code checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. No claim of independent validation or absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Binary exact-weight substitution channel; two largest distinct three-center sphere intersection values are established only for integers t>=2, n>=4t. No guarantee of efficient decoding, extension to other alphabets, or smallest possible n/t threshold. Potential unlocated implicit equivalent in general ball-intersection literature.
title: Sharp first and second triple-sphere intersections for fixed-weight binary reconstruction
